data.name: 5th Dimension
data.detailed_description:
5th Dimension is a virtual world like no other. Players compete in a battle for control between the Nirvay and the Sah Vii factions as they build cities, conquer territory and create high-tech robotic humanoids called Mechs that they control to win in an array of adrenalin-fueled competitions, from deathmatch battles to hi-octane racing.

Battle for the glory of your faction to gain wealth and power and expand your influence over 5th Dimension as you compete for control of a limitless virtual world.


BUILD AN EMPIRE

The virtual world of 5th Dimension is a rich, expansive universe filled with untold technological wonders and captivating natural beauty. From the lush, teeming forests of the island of Indu to the massive, sparkling edifices of the metropolis of Studio City, 5th Dimension’s magic and beauty is defined both by its violent contrasts and its alluring harmony.

5th Dimension offers a rich, city-building and terraforming interface empowering players to transform landmass and build beautiful, detailed landscapes and urban settlements, ranging from sparse rural outposts to sky-scraping metropolises. The creation of new terrain expands the world-map of 5th Dimension, resulting in it growing organically over time, offering a game-space that is limited only by imagination. Create venues within the cities you have built, and finally, assemble guilds. Use your Guild to play co-op, unlocking story elements and embarking on factional quests that offer rich rewards and perilous adventure.


YOUR WORLD YOUR WAY

During early access, community members will be empowered to create the buildings and architecture within the major cities that exist on the 5 islands within the game-world, using the game's own world building and terraforming interface. Players are empowered to craft, and own, a piece of the 5th Dimension game-world.

BATTLE FOR SUPREMACYWithin the virtual world of 5th Dimension, players compete in an array of team based competitions to level up and generate wealth:

Sky Running - Control your Mech in-flight and fight off the competition in a breakneck race to the finish line within a low gravity arena filled with explosive obstacles.

Fire Flight - Race against the competition and the clock to escape a burning maze filled with lethal obstacles and terrifying pitfalls all while attempting to destroy sentient robotic predators who's mission in life is to extinguish yours. 

Hyperdrive -  Adrenaline fuelled drag racing and inner city urban street racing.

Thud Rumble - Bring your A game and go head to head with opposing faction members in a no holds barred, ‘last mech standing’ combative battle for supremacy.

Players participate in these battles by controlling high tech robotic humanoids known as 'Mechs'. Mechs are A.I. powered, virtual beings designed by players using a rich mech building interface. Develop your Mech using a varied specialization pathway, focusing on 4 key functions - Agility, Flight, Muscle & Power. Blend these abilities in a myriad of ways to build the Mech you need for the specific battle you are taking on, and leave your opponent no chance for victory.

Please Note: The images shows on this page are concept art.

data.short_description: 5th Dimension is a cyberpunk world builder and RPG MMO that empowers players to create, and then control a limitless virtual world. Build game worlds, design high-tech robotic humanoids and compete in an array of adrenaline fuelled competitions to exert your influence on the world you’ve built.
